title: Read a product label. Get a clean record.
body: An AI tool that reads product labels, pulls out the key facts, and sends them to a person to check before anything is saved.
detail: Partner product labels arrive as photos and PDFs. Typing them into a database by hand is slow and error-prone. This tool does the first pass and leaves the final call to a reviewer.

sections.label: THE PROBLEM
sections.copy: Every label is laid out differently. Ingredients, doses, and claims sit in images or PDFs, and copying them by hand creates quiet mistakes.

sections.label: HOW IT WORKS
sections.copy: Upload a label. The AI transcribes it, extracts the fields into a fixed format, and shows where each value came from on the label. A reviewer approves or fixes each field. Only approved data is sent to the team database, with a notification when it is done.

sections.label: WHY IT IS BUILT THIS WAY
sections.copy: AI does the tedious part. A person keeps the final say. Every change is versioned, so you can see what changed on a label and when.

sections.label: STATUS
sections.copy: Internal prototype. Not a public service.
